prompt:
Create one full-body Vietnamese market vendor NPC as a clean game sprite. Match the visual language of the provided game screenshot and the approved vegetable-vendor reference: hand-drawn 2D Vietnamese mobile game character, dark slightly uneven ink outlines, readable silhouette, matte flat colors with only simple two-step cel shading, modest texture and imperfect human linework. Keep the same grounded adult proportions as the approved vendor (head only mildly oversized, not toddler-like); small simple eyes, natural face, subtle asymmetry. The person should feel like an ordinary local market seller: quietly funny through a dry, mildly tired or knowing expression, not through a goofy pose.

Pose: standing still, facing the viewer, full body from head to feet, shoulders relaxed, feet naturally apart, both arms hanging comfortably by the sides, hands relaxed. Neutral idle base pose only. The final character will be used for a very subtle up-and-down breathing/bobbing animation, so the pose and clothing silhouette must stay stable. Keep the whole body centered with generous transparent margin, no crop.

Important style limits: calm and likeable, slightly humorous, not exuberant or childish. No huge sparkling eyes, no rosy cheeks, no wink, no open-mouth grin, no jumping, dancing, waving, pointing, sales gesture, exaggerated chibi body, glossy highlights, painterly realism, 3D render, photo look, dramatic studio lighting or complex effects. Use muted everyday clothing colors, crisp dark outer contour and simple readable facial features. Plain solid magenta #FF00FF background only, evenly lit, no cast shadow beyond the feet, no props except those specifically listed for this character. One character only.

CHARACTER: A stocky Vietnamese woman butcher in her late 40s, round practical face, short black hair mostly tucked beneath a faded maroon-and-cream checked headscarf, half-lidded observant eyes and a tiny one-sided closed-mouth smirk. Wears a worn pale sage short-sleeve blouse, dark wine-red butcher apron, dark cropped trousers and simple rubber sandals. A small clean white towel tucked at the apron waist. No knife, no blood, no meat props. Her expression should read capable and mildly amused, not angry or cute.

Seen from the front: the whole body and head turned to face the viewer squarely, the chest, hips and the toes of both feet pointing straight at the viewer and the face centred between both ears, looking straight out of the image, not turned toward either side even when a reference picture shows the character from another angle.
